capabilities: Sync wiki notes with a vault folder
Add wikis by search or pasted link
Send local edits back to lichen.wiki
Keep conflicting edits in a conflicts folder
Sign in with a Bluesky or atproto handle
extras: Public wikis sync without an account; sending edits requires Bluesky/atproto sign-in stored in Obsidian's secret storage. No telemetry; contacts lichen.wiki, the user's PDS and sign-in server, public.api.bsky.app, cdn.bsky.app, plc.directory, and typeahead.waow.tech.
problem: Lichen wikis can only be edited on lichen.wiki, with no way to work on their notes as local Markdown files in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: a sync brings lichen.wiki's changes into your files and sends your edits back

summary: Two-way sync between Lichen wikis and a vault folder, bringing lichen.wiki notes in as Markdown files and sending local edits back.
